notes.material: Every imported opaque pixel is sampled from a saved built-in image-generation PNG; no procedural anatomy is added to these source frames.
notes.timing: The source cartridge animation lists, frame counts, timing and intentional blanks are preserved. Repeated source poses retain native phase slots; only full-frame mirroring is used.
notes.coverage: Only generated poses with matching visible action and direction are mapped. Unmapped roles remain the earlier artwork and are enumerated in coverage.json. This is a partial raster migration.
notes.nativeMirrors: Right-facing roles mirror the generated left-facing pixels to use native tile sharing. Explicit source-right drawings remain archived for review.
notes.missingSources: No native role is uncovered after story-v2 and finishing-v1. All source frame IDs and both equipment variants still require exact native upload and settled PPU verification.
orientationCorrections: Combat cells2 and3 both face left; together they provide opposite running contacts.
Story cell1 is right-facing blink and cell3 is right-facing look-back; both are mirrored for left.
notes.phaseReuse: Front/back run have one saved contact pose, reused across native timing. Side run, draw and attacks use distinct generated limb/body poses. Back slash uses saved high guard followed by the lowered sword guard; there is no separate rear extension.
notes.proportions: Native30pixel ordinary standing height with full-silhouette32pixel exceptions; complete PNG silhouettes remain inside the native32×32 frame.
notes.lowPoses: Generated front/side kneeling and rear crouching poses cover the native low kneel/crouch states without changing native timing.
notes.derivedSequences: Rear draw progresses from saved rear idle to diagonal guard to raised weapon. Awakening power progresses from kneeling/crouching to raised weapon and battle guard, preserving visibly equipped weapon distinction. Rear blink reuses the rear idle because eyes are not visible from the back; this is a visually identical blink state, not an unrelated missing gesture.
